## Purpose and scope

This companion governs the assets that sit between model outputs and public-facing warning decisions: warning threshold configurations, trigger criteria, issuance records, and the tools that automate or support warning decisions.

**In scope:**

- Tier classification for warning assets
- Version control requirements for threshold configurations
- Run record requirements for warning-linked model outputs
- Audit trail obligations for warning decisions

**Out of scope:**

- The models that produce forecast inputs (see @sec-flood-model-governance)
- Operational warning procedures (see @sec-procedure-tools)
- Impact information and result threshold methodology (covered by the Warning Team's own operational documentation)
